title: Lesson 46: Using the Debug Console
description: Use the Debug Console to identify failures and implement resolutions.

questions.question: Which tool shows request/response logs for OmniStudio components per session?
questions.explanation: The Debug Console captures per-session request/response logs.

questions.question: What is the FIRST thing to read in a Debug Console entry?
options: The request and response payloads of the failing call
questions.explanation: Payloads carry the evidence. Compare request vs response.

questions.question: How do you isolate one user's failing interaction in the console?
questions.explanation: Session IDs tie interactions to their logs for isolation.
